description: List every exchange this server supports (built from ccxt.exchanges at runtime), with name, websocket and prediction-market availability. Filter by a name query or by support for a unified method.

prediction.description: true: only prediction-market exchanges; false: exclude them

query.description: case-insensitive substring match on the exchange id or name

supports.description: keep only exchanges supporting this unified method, e.g. "fetchOHLCV"

name: list_exchanges
title: List supported exchanges
